data.narrative:
Pickle Robot Company is a Series B robotics and manufacturing venture that has raised $97M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of nine private peers and one public comparable (ticker 277810.KQ), with primary focus on three same-stage, same-sector private companies: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $97M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B-to-next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $184M. Peer-median methodology benchmarks against the three identified comparables, yielding a median valuation of $1.8B with a range spanning $1.6B to $2.0B. The substantial gap between methods reflects both the early-stage, capital-intensive nature of the target and the high valuations commanded by later-stage robotics peers.

The triangulated analysis produces a low of $157M, median of $967M, and high of $2.0B. The median reflects the arithmetic midpoint across both methods. Key uncertainties include the appropriateness of applying late-stage peer multiples to a Series B company, the maturity and revenue profile of comparable firms relative to Pickle, and whether the target's specific technical positioning and customer traction justify premium or discount to peer medians.
